list.name: UI Elements & Layout
list.description: warpui_core's renderable element and layout tree — flex, table, stack, scrollable, drag, alignment, container box-model and text elements that compose into the view hierarchy.

list.name: UI Components

list.name: Keymap / Input Engine

list.name: Text & Fonts

list.name: Rendering, Platform & Windowing

list.name: Editor Content Model

list.name: Editor Rendering & Decoration

list.name: Vim Modal Engine
list.description: The standalone modal-editing library — the vim state machine, motions, text objects, find-char, iterators and registers that drive vim-style editing over the editor's buffers.

list.name: Telemetry, Tooling & Project Support
